content:
It's time to check out the best new iPhone 18 Pro cases for this year. Apple has released a series of new color-matched silicone and TechWoven models, along with our tried-and-true favorites from major third-party brands. Among them are a brand new burgundy model with a built-in stand, ultra-grippy customizable options, as well as premium leather cases from brands like Nomad and Burton Goods. There are also some super affordable models from budget-friendly brands like Spigen starting at just $14.

Best iPhone 18 Pro Cases

Updated 9/27: Added several exclusive discount codes for 9to5 readers to this post.

Apple

Featured Partner: ESR

The all-new ESR iPhone 18 Pro case and accessory lineup is here, featuring premium color pairings, patented technology, and more. The star of the show this time is the latest Atelier Vegan Leather Magnetic case with a built-in zinc-alloy Flex stand to protect the camera plateau, offering 3x military-grade protection and a "soft elastic touch for a comfortable grip." Like the rest of the new Atelier and accessory lineup, this one comes in four colors designed to perfectly complement the new Burgundy, Glacial, Black, and Silver iPhone 18 Pro models.

  • ESR Atelier Vegan Leather Magnetic Case with Flex Stand $42 (was $46) | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR UltraFit Armorite Pro Screen Protector $30 | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR Cyber FlickLock Magnetic Case $21 | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR Geo Magnetic Wallet with Stand (with Grip) $46 (was $50) | Amazon or ESR

Nomad

When it comes to leather cases, Nomad is hands down one of the best in the game, and their flagship models now fully support the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max. This year, they're also rolling out a brand-new Rugged Case series, with each colorway engraved with topographical patterns of the Baja California Peninsula:

  • Rugged Case $70
  • Colors: Norte, Balandra, Arroyo
  • Clear Leather $69
  • Colors: Saddle, Rustic Brown, Black
  • Magnetic Leather Back $59
  • Colors: Burgundy, Saddle, Rustic Brown, Black, Olde Dublin
  • Sport Case $55
  • Colors: Black, Driftwood, Rosewood, Lunar Gray
  • Modern Leather Case $69 – $89
  • Traditional Leather Case $79 – $99
  • Rugged Leather Case $79
  • Colors: Rustic Brown

Featured Partner: Dbrand

Dbrand is ready with their Grip case for iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max. Beyond the clean design and ultra-grippy feel, it's once again compatible with tons of customizable skins, and you can score a discount on the matching Prism screen protector when you bundle it with your new case.

  • Dbrand Grip iPhone 18 Pro/Max Case $55 Customizable style, shock-absorbing protection, ultra-grippy texture, tactile buttons
  • Dbrand Prism 2.0 iPhone 18 Pro/Max 2-Pack $35 ($5 off with case purchase) Foolproof install, auto-alignment, zero dust

Dbrand is also rolling out a brand-new MNML branded case this year starting at $39, with an ultra-clean design aesthetic, a more accessible price point, MagSafe support, and buttons that retain the crisp, clicky press feel the brand is known for.

  • Dbrand MNML iPhone 18 Pro/Max Case $39 Black, Navy Blue, Tan, Burgundy

****Note: SANDMARC's products traditionally only go on sale once per year...unless you use the exclusive code above.

Bluebonnet

Bluebonnet is a small Texas-based shop that handcrafts full-grain leather cases with a seamless, all-leather design—no plastic whatsoever—paired with copper-plated metal buttons. They're also offering 9to5 readers 20% off the new iPhone 18 Pro series:

  • Minimalist Full-Grain Leather iPhone 18 Pro MagSafe Case $63 (was $79) Use code 9to5 at checkout

Luriax

  • The Signature Suede-like iPhone 18 Pro Case $107 (was $120) Use code 9TO5 at checkout
  • The Modern Suede-like iPhone 18 Pro Case $62 (was $69)

Arc

The 2026 Arc Pulse aerospace-grade metal bumper case has arrived, and this year it comes in new colors designed to complement the Glacial and Burgundy iPhone finishes:

  • Matte Black – $69.99

  • Polished Graphite – $99.99

  • Matte Deep Red – $119.99

  • iPhone 18 Series All-Leather Case $59

  • Removable magnetic back panel lets you switch freely between two modes. With back panel attached: full-grain leather case with a slim design that's MagSafe compatible

Burton Goods

UAG

UAG has also rolled out a lineup of cases for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, including their usual rugged options with reinforced corner protection, grippy bumpers, and several models focused on drop protection. If you want something more heavy-duty for rough handling, UAG's lineup is definitely worth a look.

  • UAG Mouve $65 for iPhone Duo
  • EGO TACTICAL UAG Urban Armor Gear Pathfinder Case $80 for iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max
  • UAG Civilian Anti-Slip Case starting at $60
  • And more...

YETI iPhone 18 Pro/18 Pro Max Case

If you're looking for a rugged case for your new iPhone but don't want to go with one of the more mainstream options like OtterBox or UAG, check out YETI's LoadOut series. These cases are MIL-STD-810H drop-tested for reliable protection while supporting MagSafe and featuring a built-in rotating kickstand for hands-free convenience.

Mous

If you're after something a bit more premium for your iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max that won't add too much bulk, definitely don't sleep on Mous. Right now, they have ultra-thin Aramid fiber cases made specifically for the iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max, plus the other picks below.

  • Mous Limitless MagSafe Case $75
  • Mous Clear Case $70
  • Mouse Limitless Aramid Fiber Case $85
  • Mous Thin MagSafe Case $55
  • Mouse Thin Aramid Fiber Case $70
  • And more...

Aulumu

AULUMU's iPhone 18 Pro cases are a bit more forward-thinking with futuristic styling, slim profiles, and texture treatments that make them stand out from the typical case offerings.

  • Aulumu A18 Ultra-Thin Aramid Fiber Case $66
  • Aulumu A18 Pro Drop Case $60 for iPhone 18 Pro
  • Aulumu A18 Frosted Case $40

Pitaka

If you want something even slimmer for your iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max, PITAKA is your go-to. Their cases typically feature lightweight Aramid fiber with clean, understated designs while retaining MagSafe compatibility and adding extra protection around the camera and edges.

  • Pitaka Edge Aramid Fiber Weave Case $60
  • Pitaka Summa Military-Grade Drop Protection Aramid Case $80
  • Pitaka Cairn Rugged Case $60

OtterBox iPhone 18 Pro Series Cases

OtterBox also has a robust lineup of cases for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, ranging from everyday slim options to rugged heavy-duty models to suit different protection needs. Many of the newer models support MagSafe, and some options add extra features like grippy edges, accessory storage slots, raised camera protection, and built-in stands, so you can choose based on your own thickness and protection preferences.

  • OtterBox Defender Series Pro $70
  • OtterBox Commuter Series $50
  • OtterBox Symmetry Series with Stand $60
  • OtterBox Sole Series $60
  • And more...

Belkin

If you're after something cleaner and lighter than a full rugged case for your iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max, Belkin is a solid option. Their lineup covers MagSafe-compatible clear and protective cases with raised edges around the screen and camera, and some models (like the Protect+) add reinforced corners for a nice balance of everyday protection and slim looks.

  • Belkin Clear MagSafe Case $30
  • Belkin Qi2 Compatible MagSafe Case with Grip $50
  • Belkin Protect+ Case with Airbag Corners $60

CASETiFY

CASETiFY is always one of the first brands out with new iPhone cases, and they've fully launched their lineup for the iPhone 18 Pro series with plenty of options. The brand is best known for their colorful designs, bold prints, and protective cases that don't look too utilitarian. Most of their models support MagSafe, and they offer clear, impact-resistant, and fashion-forward styles.

  • CASETiFY Ripple Silicone Case $56
  • CASETiFY Impact Ring Stand Case $64
  • CASETiFY Mirror Case with MagSafe $64
  • And more...

Speck

Speck's lineup for the iPhone 18 Pro series carries on the brand's everyday protective style with clean designs. Among them are plenty of slim, grippy cases, plus MagSafe-compatible models and clear options so your phone's original color can show through. They offer solid drop protection without making the phone too bulky.

  • Speck Presidio Clear Grip Case $50 for iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max
  • Speck Presidio 2 Grip ClickLock Case with MagSafe $50
  • Speck CandyShell Icon Case with MagSafe $40
  • And more...

elago

elago's cases lean toward clean, minimalist designs and tend to be more affordable than other options. Their lineup usually includes slim silicone, clear, and MagSafe-compatible models, plus plenty of straightforward colorways that pair easily with Apple's phone finishes.

  • elago Urban Clear Case $14 (was $16)
  • elago Pebble Case $15 (was $17)
  • elago Ring Stand Armor Case $19 (was $25)
  • elago Ridge Silicone Case $19
  • And more...
